arguments.initial_message: Build a one-page website for a small villa rental. It needs: a hero section that prominently shows the villa's name; a photo gallery displayed as a grid; a three-column list of amenities; a booking-request form that collects the guest's name, check-in date, check-out date, and a message; and a footer with contact details. Please give it a professional, calm look and feel.
